notes.title: Episode Two Finally Online!
notes.content:
[h1]Episode Two Finally Online![/h1]

The Shape of Heart now supports 7 languages. Starting from in Episode Two, Japanese, Korean, Traditional Chinese, and French are added to the game!
In addition to a brand new episode, we have made some improvements to the game too, such as:
 [*]Improved interaction experience in certain scenes. 
 [*]Applied shortcut keys for certain items
 [*]Added Episode Mode for players who have completed an Episode and needs to play it again.
 [*] Improved liquid flow and sound effort details.
 [*]Resolved some known bugs in previous versions.

If you encounter any difficulty when playing the game, please submit your feedback in the Community Discussions. Thank you!

notes.title: V0.4.10 Update Notes
notes.content:
[h1]This update includes:[/h1]

* Added difficulty selection for the mini games, while players can still challenge for hard difficulties to unlock relevant achievements.
* Revised an issue about memory leak. We won’t occupy your precious memory space any more.
* Revised an issue that mini games do not response and UI gets overlapped.

notes.title: 0.4.9 Update is live
notes.content:
[h1]Thank you all for supporting The Shape of Heart! We have received many feedbacks and advices from our players. This update includes:[/h1]
* Revised an issue that texts are incorrectly displayed in game.
* Revised an issue that texts are missing in certain languages that the game does not support.
* Revised an issue that Plumber Bros the mini game does not response when in-game language is changed.
* Added a function that players can see a “Saving” indicator on the top-right corner.
* Revised an issue that Loading is missing in the Lowered the difficulty of Blocks the mini game, but players can still choose to challenge the hard mode.
* Optimized visual effect of the game.
* Optimized audio effect of the game.


[h1]We will continue to update and improve the game quality. The next update will include:[/h1]
* Revise an issue that the mouse cursor is incorrectly displayed when multiple monitors are used.
* Add difficulty selection for the mini games, and optimize the game curve.
* Revise an issue that the game gets lagging when saving.
* Revise some issues about memory leak and improve game performance.
